title: 第1619章 阿四
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林风早就听闻，渡硬国是送妹狂魔国度，之前还觉得天王小题大做。

像湿婆教主，伊姆这样的人可能没多少。

结果。。没想到在这里也能听到送妹的，还挺流行！

【这是…他们这边的什么谚语吗？被系统翻译错了？】

林风满脸纠结的看向剑不凡。

后者也无语：【老大。。我不知道啊~~】

然而，有其他人喊话道。

【你想下去？呵呵，你妹妹漂亮吗？】

【私聊发给我看看，我满意了，帮你！】

【你是哪个种族的？】

没想到，渡硬国玩家还真的认真询问起来，直接给林风二人干懵了。

【就。。这么明目张胆吗？】

【真送啊？】

【额，看样子，还有点送不出。】

【我知道渡硬国有种族制，送妹还看这个吗？】

这一切都让林风和剑不凡无法理解。

那人名叫阿四，只有1重天修为，也就是世界上说的1阶。

没看出是什么职业。

他被鼹鼠攻击，每次攻击他都扣掉三分之一血量，根本扛不住，才不得不求助其他人。

几乎所有人都没有怀疑他送妹的决心。

问他要照片。

剑不凡啧啧称奇：【渡硬国人。。真是奇葩啊！】

【那可不一定。】

林风冲后面喊道：【喂，我帮你！】

剑不凡瞪大眼睛看着林风：【老大。。你……要啊~~】

【滚犊子。。我非但要帮你，我还不需要你送我妹妹！】

阿四：【真。。真的？？】

【我们大夏人不骗人。】

【我还是找我们渡硬国人吧。】

显然，这个家伙不相信林风。

林风对剑不凡使了个眼神：【帮他！】

【不是~~老大。。妹妹为什么不要啊？】

【你要就给你~~】

【咳咳，我只是随便说说。】

剑不凡只是不明白林风为什么要这样做。

明明对方给妹妹。。他非但不要，还免费帮人家，关键人家还不信任他。

不过他对林风百分百信任，想不通归想不通，还是去帮忙。

Lin Feng had long heard that Dujiang Country was a country where girls were crazy about sending girls. Before, he thought that the King of Heaven was making a fuss out of a molehill.

There may not be many people like Lord Shiva, Im.

result..I didn’t expect to hear escort girls here, it’s quite popular!

Lin Feng looked at Jian Bufan with a troubled face.

The latter was also speechless: [Boss..I don’t know~~]

However, someone else shouted.

【Do you want to go down?Haha, is your sister pretty?】

[Private message and send it to me for a look. I’m satisfied and I’ll help you!】

[What race are you from?】

Unexpectedly, the players from the Crossing Hard Country actually started asking questions seriously, leaving Lin Feng and the two of them confused.

【At once..So blatant?】

【Really?】

[Well, it looks like I still have a little bit to give.】

[I know that Du Hard Country has a racial system. Do you still read this when sending girls?】

All this was beyond comprehension for Lin Feng and Jian Bufan.

That man's name was Ah Si, and he only had a level 1 heavenly cultivation level, which is what the world calls Level 1.

I didn't see what occupation it was.

He was attacked by a mole, and each attack deducted one-third of his health. He couldn't hold it back, so he had to ask for help from others.

Almost no one doubted his determination to send his sister.

Ask him for a photo.

Jian Bufan clicked his tongue and said in amazement: [Du Jingguo..What a weird thing!】

[That’s not necessarily the case.】

Lin Feng shouted from behind: [Hey, let me help you!】

Jian Bufan stared at Lin Feng with wide eyes: [Boss..You...want it~~]

[Get lost..Not only do I want to help you, I don’t need you to send me my sister!】

Ah Si: [True..real??】

[We Daxia people don’t lie.】

[I’d better find us to cross the hard country.】

Obviously, this guy doesn't believe Lin Feng.

Lin Feng glanced at Jian Bufan: [Help him!】

【No~~boss..Why don't you want it, sister?】

【I’ll give it to you if you want it~~】

[Ahem, I'm just talking casually.】

Jian Bufan just didn't understand why Lin Feng did this.

Obviously the other party gave it to my sister..Not only did he not want it, he also helped people for free. The key point is that people still don't trust him.

However, he had 100% trust in Lin Feng. Even if he couldn't figure it out, he still went to help.
